Blue Fluorite on Bladed Matrix
Geological Crystal Cluster
8" x 6" x 6"

This natural mineral specimen features translucent light blue fluorite crystals within a creamy-white bladed matrix. The fluorite displays a cubic habit, contrasting with the intricate, petal-like structures of the matrix. This piece serves as a significant geological sample and striking decorative object, showcasing the complex geometry of natural crystal growth.
Light blue fluorite crystal clusters distributed across the surface
Dense bladed matrix with desert rose formations and textural variety
Substantial cabinet-sized specimen suitable for display
Condition:
Very good natural condition. The specimen maintains structural integrity with defined crystal faces. Natural variations are present, consistent with a geological specimen.
